overview: NIT Innovation & Entrepreneurship Development Centre is a facility at NITK Surathkal aimed at fostering innovation and entrepreneurship among students and faculty. It supports startup activities through mentoring, infrastructure, and industry linkages. The centre is part of NITK's broader efforts to promote research, innovation, and technology transfer.
objectives: Promote innovation and entrepreneurship among students and faculty
Provide mentoring and infrastructure support to startups
Strengthen industry-institute linkages for technology transfer
Encourage student participation in national innovation programs
eligibility: Open to students, faculty, and alumni of NITK Surathkal who are engaged in innovative projects or startup ideas. Specific eligibility may vary based on the program or grant being applied for under the centre's activities.
benefits: Access to incubation infrastructure, mentorship from faculty and industry experts, networking opportunities, support for patent filing and technology transfer, assistance in applying for government grants and funding schemes, and participation in entrepreneurship development programs.
financial_support: The centre facilitates access to various funding sources such as DST NIDHI Prayas Grant, CSR grants, and sponsored research projects. Financial support varies by program and is not standardized; examples include grants like Rs. 9.3 lakh under DST NIDHI Prayas for startups like Oxyheal Pvt. Ltd.
application_process: 1. Identify the relevant program or grant under NIT Innovation & Entrepreneurship Development Centre. 2. Check eligibility criteria for the specific opportunity. 3. Prepare required documents such as project proposal, team details, and proof of concept. 4. Submit application through the designated portal or contact the centre directly. 5. Await review and potential interview or presentation. 6. Upon approval, receive mentorship, infrastructure, and/or financial support as per the scheme.
required_documents: Proof of concept or prototype details
Identity and address proof of applicants
Any existing patent or research documentation
deadlines: Varies by program; some are rolling basis, others have specific dates as announced
implementing_agency: National Institute of Technology Karnataka (NITK), Surathkal
caveats: Financial support is not guaranteed and depends on external funding availability
Incubation support is subject to periodic review and performance
Some programs may have specific sectoral or technological focus
Intellectual property rights may be governed by institute policies
